title.narrative: Multi-year support to the UN Department of Political Affairs (DDPA)

description.narrative: Support the UN Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs (DPPAs) work in conflict prevention, mediation and peacebuilding.

The result framework for DPPA's strategic plan 2023-2026 is accessible here: https://dppa.un.org/sites/default/files/results_framework_2023-2026_external_0.pdf DPPA strategic plan 2023-2026: https://dppa.un.org/sites/default/files/dppa_strategic_plan_2023-2026.pdf DPPA Multi-Year Appeal 2023-2026: https://dppa.un.org/en/multi-year-appeal-2023-2026 Expected key results of the Danish contribution, as specified in the cover note for Denmark's Organisation Strategy are Timely, integrated, multidimensional, age-sensitive, gender-responsive, data-driven and climate-informed analysis; Longer-term prevention and peacebuilding support; More effective multilateralism through support to UN bodies; Institutional learning, innovation, diversity, and collaborative practices informing responses.
